defs.def: the woman that a man is married to; a married woman 妻子；太太；夫人；已婚妇女

ex.s: He and his wife began looking for a place in Manhattan.
ex.t: 他和妻子开始物色曼哈顿的一处住所。

ex.s: Being a mother and wife has helped her become the woman she is.
ex.t: 作为母亲和妻子帮助她成为了自己的女人。

ex.s: My wife and I wanted to share our new home with family and friends by hosting a small gathering in the early summer.
ex.t: 我和妻子想在初夏举办一个小聚会，与亲友分享我们的新家。

ex.s: My wife suggested I get in touch with my brother, but I resisted, thinking he should call first.
ex.t: 我妻子建议我和我弟弟取得联系，但我抗拒，觉得应该他先打电话。

ex.s: He was facing health issues and his wife of thirty-five years had passed away a few months earlier.
ex.t: 他正面临健康问题，而与他结发三十五年的妻子在几个月前去世了。

ex.s: With the biscuits my wife had made, I arrived at my brother’s door.
ex.t: 带着我妻子做的饼干，我来到了我兄弟的家门口。

ex.s: But it can certainly keep me entertained while I wait for my wife to rescue me.
ex.t: 但它肯定能在我等妻子来解救我的时候让我保持愉悦。

ex.s: The man’s wife.
ex.t: 男士的妻子。

ex.s: Mike Sullivan, a former construction worker, took up woodworking after he and his wife, Judy, retired.
ex.t: 迈克·沙利文是一名前建筑工人，他和妻子朱迪退休后开始从事木工。

ex.s: Husband and wife.
ex.t: 丈夫和妻子。

ex.s: I wasn't worried about bringing them into my home with my wife and kids.
ex.t: 我并不担心把它们带进我和妻子、孩子共同生活的家里。

ex.s: Generation Xers with young families, like my wife and I, can still find it convenient to have a home phone rather than providing a mobile phone for every family member.
ex.t: 像我和妻子这样有年幼家庭的X世代人，仍然会觉得家中有一部座机电话很方便，而不必为每个家庭成员都配一部手机。

ex.s: There was a man sick in bed, his wife, who took care of him and could not go out to work, and their little boy.
ex.t: 有一位生病卧床的男人，他的妻子照顾他、无法外出工作，还有他们的小男孩。

ex.s: There was a man sick in bed, his wife, who took care of him and could not go out to work, and their little boy.
ex.t: 有一位生病卧床的男人，他的妻子照顾他、无法外出工作，还有他们的小男孩。

ex.s: Since our twins began learning to walk, my wife and I have kept telling them that our sliding glass door is just a window.
ex.t: 自从我们的双胞胎开始学走路，我和妻子就一直告诉他们，我们的玻璃推拉门只是一扇窗户。

ex.s: The doorway to peace and quiet, for Nick Bright at least, leads straight to his mother-in-law, she lives on the ground floor, while he lives upstairs with his wife and their two daughters.
ex.t: 对于Nick Bright来说，通往宁静的入口直通他岳母那里，她住在一楼，而他楼上和妻子及两个女儿住在一起。

ex.s: One fall，my wife Elli and I had a single goal:to photograph polar bears.
ex.t: 有一年秋天，我和妻子埃利只有一个目标：拍摄北极熊。

ex.s: Husband and wife.
ex.t: 丈夫和妻子。

ex.s: His wife Tina cooked us a delicious dinner and we got to know his sons Ryan and Kyle.
ex.t: 他的妻子蒂娜为我们做了一顿美味的晚餐，我们认识了她的儿子瑞恩和凯尔。

ex.s: As I approached mile 23, I could see my wife waving a sign.
ex.t: 接近23英里时，我看见妻子挥舞着牌子。

ex.s: My wife and I booth work full-time, so life can get pretty busy!
ex.t: 我妻子和我都是全职工作，所以生活可以变得相当忙碌！

ex.s: That all changed in 1988 when his wife Grete found a forgotten journal at home.
ex.t: 1988年一切都改变了，他的妻子格蕾特在家里发现了一本被遗忘的日记。

ex.s: His wife baked and sold cookies to raise money.
ex.t: 他的妻子烤饼干来筹钱。

ex.s: The emperor loved his wife so much that when she died, he built the Taj Mahal in her memory.
ex.t: 皇帝深爱他的妻子，当她去世时，他建造了泰姬陵以纪念她。

ex.s: NAME INFORMATION Song Qingling Dr Sun Yat-sen’s wife; one of the top leaders in modern Chinese history; devoted her life to improving the welfare of women and children 5 Have you done all what you can to help the people in need?
ex.t: 姓名信息 宋庆龄 孙中山夫人；中国现代史上最杰出的领导人之一；毕生致力于改善妇女儿童福祉 5 你是否已竭尽所能去帮助有需要的人？
